gap: No result ChatGPT got states that, on the makers' own US stores today, the ANRAN G1 with its solar panel costs $64.99 (ChatGPT showed $105.99 at Best Buy) and the Arenti GO3G costs $39.99 plus a $23.99 Arenti solar panel ($63.98 total), while the eufy S330 with its 4.5 W built-in panel costs $249.99, about four times as much.
standout_why: I compared against the cited Buffalo Alarm page (2026-06-01) and the cited Reolink 4G solar guide (2026-10-15). Buffalo Alarm gives rounded prices for only four models (S330 $250, Go PT Ultra $200 + $30 panel, Arlo Go 2 $250, TrackMix LTE $230) and leaves out every budget model. The Reolink guide gives no prices at all. Neither page names ANRAN or Arenti, and neither gives a dated maker-store price. ChatGPT's own budget card used a Best Buy price $41 above what ANRAN's store charges.
decides: It changes the budget pick and the price of the one we list. A solar 4G pan-tilt camera costs about $64 from the maker (ANRAN G1 $64.99 with panel, or Arenti GO3G $39.99 + $23.99 panel), not $106. The 4K picks (Reolink Go PT Ultra, eufy S330) then have to justify a $145-$185 premium with 4K and, on the S330, Wi-Fi fallback. Every model ships with only a trial of data (100 MB on Reolink, ANRAN and eufy), so the monthly plan still sets the real running cost, and I could not source those plan prices from any maker page.
